text:
jordan_sa: Orion Health POC -- they require EU data residency and want a clear path and costs. They also handed over a 40-question security questionnaire and said procurement needs latency/throughput numbers and an eval pass threshold. Can we propose a default path + timeline?

tess_eng: IMO: 1) start hosted in eu-west for fastest proof (we can show functional outputs), 2) run their prompt suite to measure accuracy and latency, 3) if steady-state needs exceed hosted SLOs -> move to dedicated reserved pool, 4) private (VPC/on-prem) only if Legal insists.

nav_ps: propose measurable success criteria to send to procurement:
- Functional: >= 92% match rate on Orion prompt set (we'll clarify scoring)
- Perf: p95 latency < 300ms (avg seq len ~120 tokens)
- Scalability: sustain 350 RPS with <1% errors during 30m soak
- Cost: estimate delta for dedicated vs hosted for expected qps (we'll provide a 3-line cost table)

mike_sre: ops notes: hosted eu-west is immediate. Dedicated provisioning for 1-2 instances (A100-class) typically 2-4 weeks; allow lead time for nvlink racks. Private needs their infra + our installer and KMS setup (legal review). Also: add cache warmup plan and a prebuilt load harness.

security_bot: Sec questionnaire link: https://redwood.internal/secq/ORION-POC. Important fields: data flows, retention, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS options, logging retention. Please complete by end of week so we can pre-clear dedicated/private options.

jordan_sa: customer asked about minimal dedicated commitment and break/fallback behavior. Can we give a conservative commit and fallback plan?

tess_eng: conservative committed pool: 4x GPU (estimate) for 350 RPS baseline. Ballpark committed monthly: ,000-,500 EUR depending on GPU class. Fallback: multi-tier routing - primary dedicated, fallback to hosted EU (same model variant) with traffic steering and rate-limits to avoid cost shock.

nav_ps: timeline suggestion (4 weeks):
W0: confirm prompt set + sample payloads; security Q kickoff
W1: hosted baseline runs + initial eval scoring
W2: tuning (prompt engineering & batching), start dedicated ordering if needed
W3: load testing, KV cache tuning, SLO verification
W4: handoff + procurement + optional private onboarding prep

mike_sre: quick API example for hosted baseline (replace KEY):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-m-1-eu","input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":150}'
```
Use this in their harness to capture latency and outputs.

jordan_sa: great. I'll draft the one-pager (path + success criteria + ballpark costs) and ask them to confirm the prompt set today. Schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 11:00 CET to finalize. :white_check_mark:

tess_eng: I'll upload a short runbook for the hosted run and a provisioning checklist for dedicated (GPU types, expected seq lengths, batch targets).

mike_sre: I'll prepare dashboards: token-cost, per-route p95, cache hit-ratio, and an incident rollback playbook.

nav_ps: I'll fill the security questionnaire prelim answers and attach the procurement cost sheet.

jordan_sa: thanks team  let's lock this tomorrow.
